user.title: Connect SIMKL
user.description: Create a free app at https://simkl.com/settings/developer/ (choose the PIN / device sign-in type), then paste its Client ID here. You approve a code on simkl.com in the next step; no password is entered in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect SIMKL
reauth_confirm.description: SIMKL rejected the saved sign-in. Continue to get a new approval code.

progress.approve: Open {url} and enter the code **{code}** while signed in to the SIMKL account you want to use. This page continues automatically once you approve.

error.cannot_start: SIMKL did not accept that Client ID. Check it and try again.

abort.already_configured: This SIMKL account is already set up.
